request.voice_description: An adult male dramatic actor with a clear, gentle mid-low baritone, neutral educated American diction and smooth, warm resonance. Patient physician and protective father: calm authority without distance or condescension. Precise consonants, supple pitch and attentive warmth; he listens even while speaking. Gratitude feels personal, a warning is quietly firm, and urgency remains controlled rather than loud. A natural conversational pace with small considered pauses, not sleepy, sermon-like or an audiobook narrator. There is kindness and moral resolve under every line. Intimate dry studio recording, no music or ambient effects.
request.text: Thank you for coming. I know what it cost you to be here. We are asking for a little patience, and a chance to show you the truth. You don't have to share our hopes. Just look carefully, ask your questions, and decide for yourself.
